The map shows a wall at x=8 (column of '#') from y=1 to y=8, with gaps at y=3 (Loose Panel 'o') and y=6 (Silver Door 'o'). The right side (x=9-12) is only reachable through those. The Silver Door at (7,6) is actually at x=7... wait, the 'o' at row 6 is at x=7. Let me re-read: row 6 is `#......o....#` — position 7 is 'o'. So the door is at (7,6), and the wall column is at x=8.

So to get to the right side, I need to pass through the door at (7,6) or the panel at (7,3). Let me try the door with KeyE.
